title: Ocean & Skyline Tranquility | KEY.co
description_expanded: Ocean & Skyline Tranquility offers an unmatched oceanfront escape, perched on the 30th floor of The Setai, Miami Beach. This luxurious two-bedroom, 1,213 sq. ft. condo showcases floor-to-ceiling windows that provide uninterrupted views of the sparkling sea and Miami’s skyline. The kitchen is a chef’s dream, featuring top-tier appliances and an in-room three-stage water filtration system, ensuring the freshest water with every sip. Every detail in this modern haven is designed to enhance your stay, from the chic interiors to the seamless blend of comfort and style. As a guest, indulge in The Setai's renowned amenities, including beachside service, three stunning pools, and serene on-site spas. The convenience of a private residence lobby and valet service ensures a stress-free arrival, while dedicated concierge services elevate your experience with personalized touches. With exclusive access to the resort’s eco-conscious and luxurious offerings, Ocean & Skyline Tranquility promises an extraordinary stay that embodies the elegance and sophistication of Miami Beach living.
